regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your kind favor of May 28th. I in- scribed Mr. Panyard's name as requested and am sending his certificate under separate cover. .I have not the least doubt that the trouble he finds himself in is meant to be a blessing in dis- guise .... If his friends promise something specially pleasing to God, and surely if he himself promised weekly Communion for 6 months - or at least month- ly - for a year, everything will be OK ....
